scope: F01-F05 and C01-C08 under FLOOD_STEMMA_BLIND_TEST.v0.1 frozen 28-feature schema
independence_fail_conditions: same reasoning instance represented as coder A and coder B
second prompt or second pass of the same state counted as a separate coder
copying, paraphrasing or editing counterpart output
counterpart feature values visible before own receipt freeze
shared mutable scratchpad containing counterpart decisions
one operator producing both outputs from a common hidden decision table
post-output relabeling of one coding pass as independent
allowed_common_inputs: same published philological reference set when explicitly logged
systemic_bias_note: Operational independence does not guarantee epistemic independence. Two coders may share training, cultural, translation or scholarly priors. Agreement is therefore a reliability observation, never independent world evidence.
receipt_rule: Every coder receipt is immutable after freeze. Corrections create a superseding receipt and preserve the original.
failure_semantics: If genuine independence cannot be demonstrated, status is SINGLE_CODER_OR_DEPENDENT_REVIEW and the pair cannot satisfy the double-coding gate.
